sampled_open_items.title: No utf-8 encoding for image filenames
sampled_open_items.body_excerpt:
Using coco files e.g. with German `Umlaute` fails for ML training, as coco files are opened in ascii encoding mode, hence filenames containing ä,ö,ü are not found.

To fix this, change 
`coco.py` line 81 from  
``` python
with open(annotation_file, 'r') as f:
```
to 
``` python
with open(annotation_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
```
